description: This Java source file defines a factory class for creating parameter resolvers used in function pipelines, including specific implementations for handling string and placeholder parameters. It provides static methods to retrieve configured resolver instances for different parameter patterns.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory providing static methods to obtain parameter resolvers for function pipelines, handling different parameter configurations and allowing creation of resolvers that validate or resolve string constants and placeholders.

methods.name: forEmptyParameters
methods.description: Returns a resolver that validates empty parameter lists.

methods.name: forStringParameter
methods.description: Returns a resolver for a single string constant parameter.

methods.name: forStringOrPlaceholderParameter
methods.description: Returns a resolver for a parameter that can be either a string constant or a placeholder.

methods.name: forTripleStringOrPlaceholderParameter
methods.description: Returns a resolver for three parameters, each of which can be a string constant or a placeholder.
